# London Bridge Flat

> A modern 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in SE1, London. Located 3 minutes from London Bridge Station, with free on-site parking, fast fibre WiFi, and a full home setup. Ideal for business travel, relocation to London, and tourism. Hosted by Zoe with a 4.8-star rating.

## Key Facts

- Address: Longstone Court, 22 Great Dover Street, SE1 4LB, London, United Kingdom
- Bedrooms: 2 (king bed in Bedroom 1; 2 singles in Bedroom 2)
- Bathrooms: 2 (en-suite to Bedroom 1 + family bathroom)
- Sleeps: Up to 6 (sofa bed in living room)
- Check-in: 15:00 | Check-out: 11:00
- Free on-site parking: yes (rare in SE1)
- No pets | No smoking | No events

## Location

- 3 minutes walk: London Bridge Station (Northern & Jubilee lines, Thameslink, South Eastern Railway)
- 5 minutes walk: Borough Market
- 5 minutes walk: The Shard
- 5 minutes walk: Guy's Hospital (Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust)
- 15 minutes walk: Tower Bridge
- 15 minutes walk: Tate Modern
- 20 minutes by Tube: Canary Wharf (Jubilee line)
- 20 minutes by Tube: West End (Northern line)

## Ideal Guests

- Corporate business travellers working in the City, Canary Wharf, or South Bank
- Professionals relocating to London who need a comfortable temporary base while flat-hunting
- NHS staff, locum doctors, visiting consultants, and King's College London medical students on clinical placement at Guy's Hospital
- Tourists visiting central London landmarks including Borough Market, The Shard, Tower Bridge, and Tate Modern

## Amenities

Free on-site parking, fast fibre WiFi, dedicated laptop workspace, fully equipped kitchen, dishwasher, washer/dryer, Smart TV with Netflix, coffee maker, balcony/patio, secure building with lift, 2 full bathrooms, fresh linen and towels, ironing facilities, crib available, room-darkening shades
